intro: {owner} is committed to making this online service accessible, in accordance with the Finnish Act on the Provision of Digital Services (306/2019). The act is based on the EU Web Accessibility Directive (2016/2102).
applies-to-site: This accessibility statement applies to the website <link>{url}</link>.
compliance-full: This website meets the level A and AA requirements of <link>WCAG 2.1</link>.
compliance-partial: This website partially meets the level A and AA requirements of <link>WCAG 2.1</link>. The exemptions are listed below.
compliance-none: This website does not meet the level A and AA requirements of <link>WCAG 2.1</link>. The exemptions are listed below.
non-compliance-below: The content listed below is non-accessible for the following reasons
when-fixed: We are continuously working to improve accessibility and will fix the listed exemptions.
prepared-how: Technical accessibility has been self-assessed by Kausal.
reviewed-on-date: The statement was last reviewed on {date}.
feedback-by-email: We are constantly working towards a better accessibility experience on this service. Did you notice something we can improve? Please send your feedback by email to <link>{email}</link>. We will respond within 14 days.
enforcement-contact: Contact information of the enforcement body
enforcement-step-1: If you find accessibility fails on the site contact the site owner first.
enforcement-step-2: Expect a response in 14 days. If you are not satisfied with the response or it does not arrive within 14 days, you can file a complaint with the supervisory authority. The website of the supervisory authority explains how the complaint is made and how it will be processed.
enforcement-body: Finnish Transport and Communications Agency Traficom, accessibility supervision
a11y-feedback-description: We are constantly working towards a better accessibility experience on this service. Did you notice something we can improve in accessibility?
a11y-feedback-prompt: Please let us know by filling and sending this form. We will respond within 14 days.
